complete_immutable_fixture.preservation: Exact full original bytes. Every label, run ID, head SHA, branch, production-job array and selector retained.
complete_immutable_fixture.actual_fixture_paths: load_config requires full dictionary equality; actual collect compares all 296 rows, statuses, problems, selectors and metadata call sequence against the original configuration.

dual_schema_contract.schema1: Unchanged check_config and absent-root explicit bootstrap. Deployed main bootstrap remains byte-exact.
dual_schema_contract.read_contract: Capture target head once. Fetch all three documents at that immutable SHA. Check all fixed ordered descriptors before child reads, then per-document Git blob/SHA256/bytes/scope/count, complete ordered run digest and original global check_config.
dual_schema_contract.invalid_child: Fail closed, no partial collection or bootstrap fallback. Actual main fixture checks MONITOR_ERROR and no prior-snapshot or collect call.
dual_schema_contract.canonical_runs_encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(runs, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False), no final newline.
dual_schema_contract.source_proof: Existing branch/head_sha/blob_sha/sha256/bytes/bootstrap retained; schema2 adds inventory_schema, three document identities, resolved_run_count and runs_sha256.

unchanged_limits_and_behavior.workflow_change: Only three path-filter entries: both explicit shard paths and complete regression fixture. Schedule, permissions, conditions, concurrency, checkout, timeouts, commands and artifact policy remain byte-exact.

migration_after_separate_review_and_host: Deploy compatible reader/checker/fixture/path filters on main while root inventory remains schema1.
Let any monitor running old code finish before root migration. Schema2 intentionally fails the old validator rather than silently hiding handles.

In one separately authorized root commit, publish manifest plus both fixed shards, preserve all rows/selectors, recompute blob/SHA256/byte counts/ordered combined digest and update inventory version/timestamp.
Authored 296-run regression splits 148+148 into 32294 and 32656 byte shard documents. No root manifest or shard data is changed by this candidate.
Keep checked-out main bootstrap schema1: main validates it before remote loading. Checking out a root schema2 inventory as the local bootstrap is unsupported.
Inspect first actual cloud snapshot for complete handles and three document proofs. No runtime qualification is asserted here.
remaining_risks: Hosted controls are authored but unexecuted; source/AST review is not execution proof.
Exactly two fixed shard paths are supported; expansion requires another explicit review, not recursion or increased limits.
Partitioning does not reduce per-run API requests or snapshot size; existing 8MiB and job-time limits remain.
Rollback to old reader requires restoring valid schema1 root first.
